entries.title: Ask HN: Who wants to be hired?

entries.title: Tell HN: Call your mom
entries.author: DanielBMarkham
entries.excerpt: Programming, gaming, startups, and other nerd activities can get pretty involved, so it's good from time to set aside time for your parents. Today is Mother's Day in the U.S. Get out of the zone for a bit. Call your mom.
entries.guide_zh: 忙于编程和创业也别忘记父母，母亲节到了请给妈妈打电话。

entries.title: Ask HN: What do you do when your entire being opposes the task at hand?
entries.author: septerr
entries.current_title: Ask HN: What do you do when your entire being opposes the task at hand?
entries.excerpt: It seems I am fighting with myself. This has happened multiple times and seriously affects the quality of my life. I am assigned a feature to implement, usually vague and something that I feel adds unnecessary complexity to the codebase. I try to reason with my managers, but usually their minds are already made up. I then struggle with finishing this feature, logging hours upon hours against it...not because it takes so long to code, but because I can't make myself do it and
entries.guide_zh: 整个身心都在抗拒手头功能开发，怎样处理这种反复发生的内耗？

entries.title: Ask HN: Who is hiring? (May 2014)
entries.author: whoishiring
entries.excerpt: Please lead with the location of the position and include the keywords INTERN, REMOTE, or VISA if the corresponding sort of candidate is welcome. Feel free to post any job that may interest HN readers from executive assistant to machine learning expert to CTO.
entries.guide_zh: 五月招聘集中帖，请列工作地点并明确实习、远程和签证安排。

entries.title: Ask HN: Idea Sunday
entries.author: jw2013
entries.excerpt: Kick start the first Idea Sunday of May. (PLEASE upvote if you like this post to be seen by more people, as someone in the previous Idea Sunday mentioned the post with less points than number of comments will be penalized in ranking. Thanks.)
entries.guide_zh: 五月第一场点子星期天，邀请大家继续分享不一定亲自去做的创意。

entries.title: Ask HN: Can we get a "Show HN:" section
entries.author: pumpkinattwelve
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Can we get a "Show HN:" section
entries.excerpt: Seems obvious that people would like to showcase their launched product (including me). I am thinking that once a "Show HN:" post got enough upvotes it would be added to the possible front page pool of links.
entries.guide_zh: 建议设立 Show HN 专区，让发布产品的帖子拥有更清楚的展示入口。

entries.title: Ask HN: As an experienced dev, how do you learn a language/framework quickly?
entries.author: nemild
entries.current_title: Ask HN: As an experienced dev, how do you learn a language/framework quickly?
entries.excerpt: Background: I've been coding off and on for 2+ decades, starting from BASIC to C/C++ to Rails/Node. Languages and frameworks change quickly, and I'm still not thrilled with the resources available to learn as an experienced developer. For example, I'm confident that I should be able to do a fair bit of iOS development with a week or two of hard work given my knowledge of C/C++, Rails, Node. My challenges with existing tools: - Books are pretty verbose and don't do a great job
entries.guide_zh: 已有多年编程经验后，怎样更快上手下一门语言或框架？

entries.title: Ask HN: Freelancer? Seeking freelancer? (May 2014)
entries.author: whoishiring
entries.excerpt: Please lead with either SEEKING WORK or SEEKING FREELANCER, your location and whether remote work is a possibility.
entries.guide_zh: 五月自由职业交流帖，让寻求合作的双方说明位置与远程可能性。

entries.title: Ask HN: How exactly does Hacker News 'points' work?
entries.author: sunilkumarc
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How exactly does Hacker News 'points' work?
entries.excerpt: I wanted to know how many upvotes should a post get to get 1 point here. Because as i have noticed 1 upvote != 1 point.
entries.guide_zh: 作者发现一次赞似乎不等于一分，询问 HN 的积分到底怎样计算。

entries.title: Ask HN: Can we do a "Who's looking for work?"
entries.author: jader201
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Can we do a "Who's looking for work?"
entries.excerpt: I was wondering if HN has considered running a monthly "Who's looking for work", similar to the "Who's hiring" posts that are run every month. Seems like this would be handy for small startups and talent to find each other, or maybe even would allow fellow HNers to help each other find a good fit via networking. Or maybe this was already attempted with bad results?
entries.guide_zh: 除了每月招聘帖，HN 是否也能定期发布“谁在找工作”？
